analysis.title: US EQUITIES COLOR: TAPE WATCHING
key_insights: Market bounced on 6 Nov 2026 with Semis up about 3.5%. The desk described the move as 'healthy' and not just a beta squeeze.
Activity was extremely quiet in the final hour of trading. Inbound client calls focused on gauging sentiment, with little follow-through into the weekend.
Long-only tickets were balanced within TMT, with some Semis supply paired with a few signs of demand. The prior day had a much clearer sell skew in 'All Things AI'.
Hedge funds finished net buyers on a broad cover bid across sectors and macro expressions. ETF share of the tape exceeded 37%, against a 28% year-to-date average, in another large top-down session.
Next week's macro events are CPI on Tuesday and PPI on Friday. The straddle to next Friday's close was priced at 2.48%.
Next week's earnings: Monday CEG, CNH, FERG, KKR, AAON, HRB, OXY, SANM, SKYD, TTD and TTWO. Tuesday CRWV. Thursday AMAT, CBRS and CSCO.
Prime book data show US equities were modestly net sold this week, with the largest single-stock net selling in 4 months, partly offset by buying in Macro Products.

Info Tech was by far the most net sold global and US sector by dollar amount. The week's percentage selling in global Tech stocks was about on par with the largest net selling weeks on record (since 2016).
Four of the top five net selling weeks in global Info Tech on record have occurred within the past five months.
US Fundamental L/S gross leverage fell 8.7 pts to 207.5%, the largest weekly decline since March 2020. Net leverage fell 3.7 pts to 43.3%, the 0th percentile on a five-year view.
